title: Mismatched curtains
text:
Mismatched curtains. I really like the print in these and the grommet top but that is where my love of them ends. The material feels awful, very rough compared to our other curtains. They are pretty thick but for the price, I expected these to be higher quality.

The biggest issue for me: the pattern doesn’t line up. The pictures on this listing clearly show they line up and yet when we put them up, they were completely off! This is just poor manufacturing on what should have been a decent quality curtain, considering the cost per panel.

My IKEA curtains are far softer and at least match for half the price per 2 panels. I can only recommend these if you are only using one panel as they look nice on their own but forget it if you’re trying to put two on a window.
